notes.title: Update V.1.3.0 — Asteroid Adventure
notes.notes:
Fixes:[list]
[*]Fixed a bug in the "Planets" mini-game where multiple button presses caused errors.
[*]Increased the spawn time of planets to give players enough time to interact with all objects.

New Features:
[*]Added a new mini-game called "Asteroids"!
It will become available once your score reaches 100,000 points.
More details about the mini-game can be found in the application.

notes.title: Clicker Time Update V1.2.1 — New Mini-Game and Improvements!
notes.notes:
New Mini-Game "Planets":
[list]
[*]Test your speed and reaction! Click on the planets appearing on the screen to earn points.
[*]Detailed rules of the mini-game can be found in the tutorial section.
[*]Updated the logic for the bonus button's spawn zone to prevent display issues.
[*]Performance optimization for a smoother gaming experience.
[*]Minor UI bugs have been fixed.

Update to version V1.2.1 now and enjoy the new features! 🚀

notes.title: Update 1.1.0: New Features and Enhancements
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed visual bugs.
[*]Added animation for the score counter.
[*]Added highlight for the score counter.
[*]Added buy and sell upgrade buttons.
[*]Added 5 new types of auto-clickers.
[*]Improved game balance.
[*]Added a bonus button that appears every 3 minutes and can give a random amount of points.
[/list]

notes.title: Achievement Fix
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

We have resolved the issue that prevented achievements from unlocking. All conditions now work correctly. Simply repeat the required actions to earn them.

Thank you for your patience and support! Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update 1.1: New FPS Counter and Feedback Panel
notes.notes: New features added: an FPS counter with display settings and a convenient feedback panel. Check out the improvements and share your impressions with us!

notes.title: Ready for Clicker Time?
notes.notes: What if every click could change an entire world? You'll find out soon... Stay tuned!
